parties:
A. S. M. Afzal Hossain ----- Appellant.
Vs.
The State ----- Opposite Party.
full_judgment: 13. The next point urged by the learned Advocate was that out of 12 charge-sheet witnesses only 7 have been examined and we regret to say 'that we do not find any explanation for the non-examination of the remaining 5 charge-sheet witnesses, although without any doubt they were material witnesses in this case. We therefore, feel that the appellant has a legitimate and justifiable grievance against the trial court in not drawing adverse presumption against the prosecution for the non-examination of almost half the material witnesses in the present case.
